name: SCP-096 COMIX Demonstration Without The Maze
desc:
SCP-096 COMIX No Maze Edition.

Watch the goofy, cartoony SCP-096 COMIX roam a giant baseplate. For more chaos, you can always buy Summon a second Comix, a gamepass.

Based on the SCP:CB Comix Mod by BatteryMaster, 50 players in one server, isn't that chaotic?

How it works:

Look at Comix's face to become the target. Once targeted, survive as long as you can. Earn the 600-second survival badge if you’re up for the challenge.

Special thanks to the two people who inspired this game.
